header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: The noticing of what was there and unnoticed. Detection finds; it does not judge.
That which notices a condition and reports it. A detector finds; it does not judge.
To settle what a thing is or will be. Determination ends a range of possibility.
The growing of a thing toward what it is becoming. Development assumes a direction and does not guarantee arrival.
A made thing that does a particular work. Also a stratagem — both are contrivances aimed at an end.
A drawing that shows how parts relate rather than how they look. A diagram is an argument in lines.
Speech passing between two parties, and the panel that interrupts to ask. Both require an answer before matters continue.
Speech passing between two, where each shapes what the other says next. Dialogue is built rather than delivered.
Short form of dictionary — values reached by name rather than by position. A named structure rather than a concept.
Words with what they mean, ordered for finding. Also values reached by name rather than position.
The stated difference between two versions. A diff shows what changed and never why.
How much effort or capacity a thing demands. Difficulty is relational — it exists between a task and whoever meets it.
A condensed account of a larger body. Also to take in and break down — both reduce something to what can be used.
Represented in discrete steps rather than continuous ones. What can be copied without loss.
The worth a being has by existing. Dignity is not earned, cannot be forfeited, and is not granted by anyone — it is the ground floor.
Of low light. Dimming reduces without removing, which is why it is gentler than turning off.
One independent direction along which a thing can vary. Add a dimension and you add a whole new way of being different.
Having independent directions along which it can vary. Each dimension adds a whole new way of being different.
Short form of directory, and of direction. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Without anything in between. Also to guide — the same word for immediacy and for steering.
The way a thing faces or moves. Also guidance given — both senses point.
Having a way it points. Direction adds an asymmetry that position alone does not have.
One who decides how a made thing is shaped and shown. The director makes none of it and answers for all of it.
A list that tells you where things are rather than holding them. A directory is a map of a place, kept in the place.
The path portion of a location, without the file itself. Where rather than what.
A difference the built world was not built for — in this house, never a deficit: the ground for building differently, with dignity inherent.
Prevented from acting, by condition or by design. Of a control switched off, or a body a world was not built for.
A gathering place of voices in named rooms — where a community speaks and its words remain. The name is borrowed irony: the platform called discord is where accord is practiced.
To find what was already there and unknown to you. Discovery uncovers; it does not invent.
The finding of what was already there and unknown. Discovery uncovers; it does not invent.
The physical ground a system's memory actually rests on. What is not on disk does not survive the power going out.
To send away without further consideration. Dismissal is a judgment made quickly, and sometimes too quickly.
To send with purpose and address — a message or a doing released toward its handler.
That which sends each thing to whatever should handle it. It decides routing and does no work itself.
To set a thing out to be seen. Showing is a choice, and what is displayed is always less than what is held.
How far apart two things are. Also the space kept deliberately between an observer and what they observe.
The spreading of something across many holders, and the pattern that spreading makes. Who gets what, and in what shape.
Moving apart from a common path. Divergence describes difference from a norm and says nothing about which is right.
A mark that separates one part from the next. It adds nothing to either side and makes both legible.
The coded instruction a living thing is built from and passes on. Also, by extension, the essential character a thing inherits.
Short form of document. A written thing kept as a reference.
A named tool for running things in isolated containers. A named tool rather than a concept.
Documentation written inside the code it describes, so the two cannot drift apart. Explanation kept where it belongs.
A written thing kept as evidence or reference. A document holds its claim still so it can be checked later.
Written explanation kept beside a thing so others can use it. Documentation is a claim, and it drifts from the truth unless tended.
The verb to-do in its present asking form — grammar's small worker, carried by names that ask questions.
A canine companion. Loyal, protective, and playful — and in this house, family.
How much control is felt in a state, from overwhelmed to in command. One of the three axes a feeling is located on.
Value given without exchange expected. A donation asks nothing back, which is what separates it from payment.
Finished, with nothing remaining. Done must be defined in advance or it never arrives.
The lawful way in — an opening with a threshold, consent's own architecture: it can be knocked on, opened, or left closed.
The opening a door stands in — the threshold itself: never locked by the leading-in, per the house's own law.
Sleep that intends to wake — capability at rest, not gone; the season between uses.
The smallest mark that can be placed. It has position and no extent, which is why it means a point.
Marked with dots — a line made of pauses; the border style of the not-yet-solid.
To bring a held thing from elsewhere onto one's own ground. The crossing that makes a copy yours.
The purple-dark theme named for the count — a palette family beloved across editors.
A version made to be revised. A draft's whole value is that it is not final.
To move a thing by pulling it along a surface. Also resistance against motion — the same word for the act and what opposes it.
To pull line from intention — making an image by hand; and to pull toward, as a well draws water.
A container that slides out of a larger body to show what it holds. Closed by default, opened on purpose.
Slow unchosen movement away from true — how records diverge from ground when nobody measures; named so it can be caught.
To take in what sustains — in this house, what a consumer does at a spring: reuse as nourishment.

Drishti (Sanskrit dṛṣṭi दृष्टि: sight, seeing; and the single point a gaze rests on so the rest of the body can be still). One Rust file in, a JSON survey of its items out, cut by syn — Rust's own grammar crate — and never by a regex. Kinds, names, line numbers, visibility and attributes for functions, structs, enums, impls, traits, consts, statics, mods, type aliases, use trees and macro calls; a struct's field names, an enum's variant names, an impl's method names and the trait it implements. SPECIAL SIGHT: a function under a tauri command attribute comes back marked as a command, carrying the attribute path that made it one — an app's COMMAND SURFACE read from the ground rather than from a roster, so the wires a front end calls by name have a truth to be checked against. It surveys ITEMS, NOT BODIES: syn holds the whole tree and only item rows are emitted, so error strings, lock calls and const values never travel; doc comments are prose and are skipped deliberately, while a derive is machinery and is carried. A file that is not Rust is refused honestly — not an empty survey a caller could mistake for an empty file, but a stated failure with the grammar's own error and a non-zero exit. A regex reading Rust is a guess that usually works; a grammar reading Rust is an answer or an honest refusal, and there is nothing in between.
The force that keeps a thing moving toward something. Also a store of data — both are things that carry.
Moved by a force that does not let up. Of a thing carried forward by something behind it rather than pulled by something ahead.
To let fall, or the smallest unit of liquid — release downward; in a base, the removal that is KP's hand alone.
A closed list that opens downward when asked. It hides its options until they are wanted, then shows them all at once.
Without moisture. Also the principle that a thing should be stated once and referenced, never repeated.
Two tones carrying a whole image — a palette of exactly two colors in conversation; also a Prism theme wearing the technique.
A second copy of the same thing. Duplicates inflate a count and are the commonest way an archive lies about its size.
How long a thing lasts. The measure of a happening from its start to its end.
Fine matter settling on everything left alone. Dust is the visible measure of how long something has not been touched.
The work a role owes — what a seat exists to do, named plainly.
Changing in response to conditions rather than fixed in advance. Of a thing decided at the moment rather than beforehand.
Obtained by what one did. In this house dignity is explicitly NOT earned — the word marks the boundary between what must be worked for and what must not.
The ground-element and the home planet — soil, foundation, and the color of both.
The shaping of a motion so it starts and stops gently. Movement made to feel like a body rather than a machine.
The direction of sunrise. One of the four bearings, fixed by the turning of the earth rather than by agreement.
Of or toward the east. A bearing made into a description of a region.
Concerning how value moves between people. Of the arrangements by which what is made reaches who needs it.
The whole system by which what is made reaches who needs it. Its root is household management — the ordering of a home.
A set of living things and their surroundings, understood as one interdependent whole. Nothing in it can be changed alone.
Where a thing ends, and the connection between two nodes. Both are boundaries that carry meaning.
To change a made thing after it is made. Editing improves and quietly rewrites the record of what was first said.
What follows from a cause. The change left behind once something has acted.
How much is achieved for what is spent. Efficiency is only meaningful once you say what was being spent.
What is spent to make a thing happen. Effort is real whether or not it produced anything.

Listen — the imperative, one syllable, the whole instruction. Irish, éist. Not "hear," which happens to you, but "listen," which you do. Live monitoring: hearing yourself in the moment you are making the sound.
Having passed, of time. Elapsed time is measured from a marked start and is the only kind that can be known exactly.
Charged and alive — energy in its quickest dress; brightness with current behind it.
One irreducible part of a larger whole. An element is chosen as a stopping point, not found as one.
Belonging to the basic constituents from which everything else is made. Of what is not reducible further.
Raised above the surrounding level. Elevation buys visibility and separation at once.
The mark showing something has been left out. An ellipsis is honest about omission where silence is not.
Short form of elements. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
A written message sent to a named address across a network. Addressed, kept, and answerable.
To set a thing inside another so it belongs there. What is embedded travels with its host.
Green gemstones, prized for depth of colour. In this house's palette, a named green rather than a general concept.
The arrival of pattern that no single part contains — the whole showing properties its pieces never held alone. How this house believes most true things happen.
A condition where ordinary process must yield to immediate need. An emergency suspends the rules and must not be declared cheaply.
Arising from the parts without being in any of them — the adjective of pattern appearing on its own.
To send outward in a chosen form — render, encode, export, publish. The gateway's verb: how a creation leaves the studio.
A small picture that carries feeling across every tongue — a made sign whose name is a search key and whose meaning is the vessel's own.
What the body reports before the mind has an argument. Emotion is information, arriving in a form that cannot be checked.
Belonging to what is felt rather than reasoned. Of the layer a body answers on before the mind speaks.
Holding nothing. An emptiness reported must be distinguished from an emptiness assumed.
Switched on and permitted to act. Enablement is a grant, and someone made it.
To make a thing take effect. Enactment turns a decision into a condition of the world.
To put meaning into a carrying form — writing a thing so it can travel and be read back true.
That which turns a thing into another form for carrying or storing. Encoding is reversible; that is what separates it from translation.
What is said to strengthen another's will to continue. Its root is heart — to encourage is to put heart back in.
The turning of a thing into a form only the intended holder can read. Encryption protects contents and never the fact of sending.
Where a thing stops, and what it was for. The same word for its finish and its purpose.
The named address a request is sent to. The far end of a line, where something is listening.
The capacity to act, and the cost of acting — a thing this house budgets honestly, in vessels and in windows alike.
The making of a rule actually hold. Enforcement is where a stated principle either has teeth or is revealed not to.
The state of being taken up with something. Also the measured attention a thing attracts — and the second sense is where the first gets exploited.
The part that supplies the motion everything else depends on. An engine does the work; the rest directs it.
To cut permanently into the surface — writing that cannot rub off; how this house marks its laws.
To make more of what a thing already is. Enhancement adds degree, not kind.
An addition that makes more of what a thing already is. Enhancement changes degree, not kind.
To add to a thing what makes it fuller without changing what it is. Enrichment deepens rather than replaces.
That which adds to a record what makes it fuller without changing what it is. It deepens rather than replaces.
The adding of depth to what already stands — more meaning laid into existing ground, never replacing it.
Several performing as one while each remains itself. The whole is the point and no part disappears into it.
To make certain a thing will hold. Ensuring adds a guarantee where there was only expectation.
Short form of entity — a thing that is, named so it can be counted. A cut fragment as it appears in this library.
A joining so deep that the parts can no longer be described separately. What happens to one is a fact about both.
A thing that is. Being itself, named as a noun so it can be counted and pointed at.
The way in. An entrance is the first thing a place says about itself.
A way in, and a thing written down. Both senses cross from outside a record to inside it.
A closed set of permitted values, named one by one. Its meaning is as much in what it excludes as in what it lists.
Environment shortened to its working name — the file and the surroundings a program reads its circumstances from.
What encloses a message for carrying. Also the shape of a sound's rise and fall over time.
The surrounding conditions a thing exists within. What is not the thing, but decides what the thing can do.
The leading-in — Aristotle's word for being led from particulars toward the whole; the walk by which a newcomer becomes at home. Greek joins the naming strata.
Short form of equaliser, and of equals. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
That which adjusts the balance across a range of frequencies. It changes what is heard without changing what was played.
The day light and dark stand equal — the year's balance point, twice kept.
A stretch of time with a character of its own. Eras are named afterward, by people who can see where they ended.
A going astray. Not a fault but a WANDERING - the word says one left the path, and says nothing about blame.
The raising of a matter to a level with more authority. Escalation admits that the present level cannot settle it.
To get out of what was holding you. Also to mark a character so it is read as itself rather than as an instruction.
To accompany another through a passage for their safety. An escort goes along rather than ahead.
What a thing is without which it would not be itself. Essence is a claim about necessity, and it is easy to overstate.
To set a thing standing so it stays — founding with intent to last.
A stated best guess, offered as a guess. An estimate becomes dangerous the moment it is quoted as a measurement.
Without end, and outside the reach of time. Of what does not depend on lasting.
So light and fine it seems not quite of the material world. Of what is present without weight.
The named continent. A named place rather than a concept.
A judging of worth or performance against a standard. Evaluation must name its standard or it is only an opinion.
Something that happened, held as a discrete thing. A moment given edges so it can be recorded and pointed at.
Change accumulated across generations, keeping what works. Evolution has direction without having intent.
Proceeding by accumulated change across generations. Of a process with direction and without intent.
To change by living — growth that keeps identity while the form learns.
To look closely in order to find out. Examination assumes something might be found that a glance would miss.
One case shown to make a general thing graspable. An example teaches and can also mislead, since one case is never the rule.
Short form of a named drawing tool. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
Goes beyond a stated bound. The word that reports a limit was passed.
A giving met by a giving — value moving both directions in one act. In this house every exchange is consensual, witnessed, and fair by construction.
To keep a thing out of a set deliberately. Exclusion is a judgment, and should be stated rather than silent.
The keeping of something out of a set. Exclusion is a judgment and should be stated rather than silent.
Execute shortened to its shell name — the word for running a thing now.
To carry a thing out. Execution is where an instruction stops being words.
The carrying out of what was planned. Execution is where a design meets what is actually there.
To be at all — the first fact about anything; in this house, already enough to be valued.
Already there before this. Of what must be reckoned with rather than designed.
Is, rather than is not. The assertion that a thing is there to be reckoned with.
To go out. An exit is what makes a place a room rather than a trap.
Opened out to show what was folded away. The contents were always there; the state changed.
Growth outward into more room than before. Expansion adds reach and takes something to sustain.
What is anticipated in advance. Expectations shape what is noticed, which is why surprises are informative.
Anticipated in advance. Expectation shapes what is noticed, which is why surprises are informative.
What it was like to undergo something. Experience is the one form of knowledge that cannot be transferred whole.
A deliberate trial arranged so its outcome will tell you something. An experiment must be able to disappoint you or it teaches nothing.
Deep capability in one domain, built by long practice. Expertise is knowing what matters here, which is why it does not transfer.
Taking value from another without fair return or real consent. Exploitation is the thing this house's license names first and forbids outright.
One who goes where they have not been in order to find out. An explorer accepts not knowing what they will meet.
To send a held thing out in a form others can use. Sovereignty over data begins with being able to export it.
Those that send held things outward in a usable form. Sovereignty over data begins with being able to export it.
To press what is inside into outward form — feeling or meaning given a body others can meet.
Puts outward what was inward. The word that reports an interior becoming shareable.
The putting outward of what was inward. Expression is not decoration; it is how an interior becomes shareable.
To reach further than before. Extension adds to what is there rather than replacing it.
Something added that reaches further than the original. An extension belongs to what it extends.
The outward faces of a thing, met before anything within. What the world sees without entering.
Belonging outside the bound. Of what is not ours to govern and must be reckoned with.
To draw a part out of a whole. What is taken keeps its meaning; what it was taken from is left changed.
The drawing of a part out of a whole. In this house the word carries a warning: extraction that takes without consent is what the license forbids.
